#### What type of PR is this?
/kind feature

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
I am the mentee of the LFX mentorship - [Kyverno: Pod Security Admission Integrations](https://mentorship.lfx.linuxfoundation.org/project/59afc794-c33e-4930-a5b8-eb3abd8d9896). In this LFX mentorship program, we want to enable fine-grained policy control, which requires detailed information returned from the upstream Pod Security library, as described in this [issue](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/111958).

We think that adding this additional field would be very helpful for external tools to adapt Pod Security, and we would love to hear your thoughts and comments on this. If this makes sense, we are more than happier to take actions and contribute to Kubernetes!

We are willing to participate in community meeting to discuss more details about it, does weekly issues/PR Triage meeting work?

> @liggitt @tallclair I believe you both were in support of making the changes needed for this?

um... not sure... if this is asking for a way to essentially generate docs for checks, that seems useful. if this is asking for a way to programmatically retrieve enough details from the checks to reimplement the checks in an external system, I'm skeptical we could come up with a sufficiently expressive system

/priority awaiting-more-evidence

This is asking about `CheckResult`, so my interpretation is it's looking for a more programmatic way of processing the output of a check, when used as a library? In that case I'd probably suggest adopting the fieldpath validation API, and include a slice of `field.Error`. For the in-tree implementation this would be a bunch of throw-away work, so for performance reasons I would want it to be opt-in by the library caller.

Kubernetes core API has lots of examples of using the fieldpath API (though note that not all of them are correct): https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/apis/core/validation/validation.go

The API is documented here: https://pkg.go.dev/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/util/validation/field

Hi @tallclair , I am the mentee of the LFX mentorship - [Kyverno: Pod Security Admission Integrations](https://mentorship.lfx.linuxfoundation.org/project/59afc794-c33e-4930-a5b8-eb3abd8d9896). There are some new progress on this issue that I would like to share with you.

We have taken your advice and add a new field named `ErrList` into `CheckResult` structure, which is a slice of `field.Error`. We set detailed errors to the `BadValue` field in `field.Error` so that we could retrieve enough information from the `checkResult` to achieve fine-grained checks in kyverno. You can see more information [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gzT5ASmL0JtvHQ18iawwW7OSO4C92s-ElSBCnJNawcQ).

Now we have forked the pod-security-admission repository and made sample changes to `check_allowPrivilegeEscalation.go` in this [commit](https://github.com/YTGhost/pod-security-admission/commit/2dfa3b726fd73ad18d1b04338e9de8cc148b7112). After testing, kyverno works well with this modification integrated to enable field-restricted exclusions.

We think that adding this additional field would be very helpful for external tools to adapt Pod Security, and we would love to hear your thoughts and comments on this. If this makes sense, we are more than happier to take actions and contribute to Kubernetes!

We are willing to participate in community meeting to discuss more details about it, does weekly issues/PR Triage meeting work?
